annotations.text:
Open question: the arc is bound to each module's own refresh rate (30s on Service Risk, 60s elsewhere). If a module has no fixed rate, the arc is omitted and only the core + ticks show.

Tell me which reading you want and I'll adjust.

DESIGN.md says: no ornamental motion on operational surfaces, and never carry state in colour or motion alone. Every loop here is bound to a real event, and live vs stale differ in shape and words before they differ in movement. See the Motion spec artboard.
